acceptanceCriteria: SproutPaceUiState losslessly carries typed fields/options/facts/actions/validation/unsaved/permission/offline/conflict state; authored values remain verbatim.

UiAction.EditField, ChooseOption, Submit and CancelDraft route only to matching ScreenAction; command actions never construct argument-less ScreenCommand in Compose. Root navigation descriptors use an explicit deterministic table and external picker/permission/privacy actions use a typed platform seam.

One stateless renderer displays real model items/facts/forms/actions for all sixteen screens; no sample_* value or no-op control is reachable in production. Text/number/date/document fields edit, booleans switch, single choices radio, multi choices checkbox, and inline validation retains values.

Every possible bundled TextKey has one deterministic Res.string mapping and complete semantically correct EN/RU resources; unknown keys are treated as contract defects, while authored content is never localized.

Compact/medium/expanded/large/extra-large layouts reflow without fixed-height copy, use approved bottom bar/rail/list-detail patterns, safe insets, 48dp targets, meaningful roles/labels/state/error semantics and keyboard-operable click actions.

Typed deterministic previews cover all 16 content screens light/dark plus required empty/error/permission/conflict/unassigned/restore/privacy/destructive states, RU 200 percent risks and AC-122 expanded screens, ready for later Paparazzi record/review.

Tests prove lossless mapping/routing, resource-key exhaustiveness, EN/RU parity, preview matrix and accessibility contract. No data/root implementation/platform/build/golden/ledger/external changes; specialist does not run Gradle.
goal: Replace sample-only production rendering with a complete Material 3 model-driven UI for all sixteen screens. Preserve every typed field/fact/action/error, route edit/choice/submit/cancel through ScreenAction, provide explicit root-navigation and platform-action seams, production EN/RU resources, adaptive layouts, accessibility semantics and deterministic typed previews/tests. Do not record goldens yet.
